Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — The broken video box on the GlasgowLive article is a Primis video advertising player that Base filter rule ||live.primis.tech^$third-party blocks; site-scoped allowlists of live.primis.tech and of all primis.tech both failed to restore playback (the ad stack is also blocked), so no acceptable rule exists and the report needs a maintainer decision.

## Still visible after the rule

- Embedded storm video player below byline/timestamp, above article body — Player shows only a still flooded-street poster with a play overlay and black caption bar reading 'STORM BOELO:⁠ DRAMATIC FOOTAGE OF FLOODED LARGS MAIN STREET - FOOTAGE BY GERALDO'S'; no playing video footage is visible.
- Article body, large grey media box below the 'Ayrshire appears...' paragraph and above the caption 'Geraldo's owner said the scenes at the shop were a disaster...' — Large empty grey rectangle where an article image/gallery should render; only the 'View 2 Images' button is visible, with no image content.
- Article body near bottom, below the 'Article continues below ADVERTISEMENT' divider and the Tha-Tien-Thai paragraphs — Large blank grey media/image placeholder begins at the lower edge; no image content is visible in the box.
- Article center column, media/video area directly below byline and timestamp, captioned 'STORM BOELO:⁠ DRAMATIC FOOTAGE OF FLOODED LARGS MAIN STREET - FOOTAGE BY GERALDO'S' — Large media/video area shows only a nighttime flood poster image with a centered circular loading spinner; no video frame or playback is visible.

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

issue.body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);

### What product do you use?

### What type of problem have you encountered?

### Where is the problem encountered?

https://www.globalcitizensolutions.com/

### Ad Blocking

### Security

### Other

### DNS filters

### Language-specific

### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled?

Send Do-Not-Track signals

### Add your comment and screenshots

The content on the website is not clickable/selectable due to the presence of `gcs-cc-lock` class on `<html>`, causing the `html.gcs-cc-lock body::before` rule to cover the page with a transparent `::before` pseudo-element. The `gcs-cc-lock` class is usually removed by accepting the cookie consent. However, since the consent is removed by the following rule, that does not occur: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/c674b6c7e2d7f265e5f12d7e9c06df5f750724d5/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_general.txt#L272

Adding `globalcitizensolutions.com##+js(remove-class, gcs-cc-lock, html)` effectively avoids the issue.

### Privacy

- [x] I agree to follow this condition

<!-- adguard-filters-agent:report {"schemaVersion":1,"revisionDigest":"ebad3929d29d1fe2d275ae64c644a14ca16bd1b010e4186da85c25aa3ab12f65"} -->
Analysis-only findings, no verified change

## Reproduced symptom

Indeterminate — Genuine filter false positive:⁠ `###moove_gdpr_cookie_info_bar` (Cookies filter, cookies_general.txt:⁠272) hides the Moov consent bar, so the theme never clears `gcs-cc-lock` from `<html>` and its fixed `body::before` overlay plus `body{overflow:hidden}` make every link unclickable and the page unscrollable (verified:⁠ elementFromPoint returns BODY, scrollY stays 0). The evidence-backed fix `globalcitizensolutions.com#%#//scriptlet('remove-class', 'gcs-cc-lock', 'html')` (cookies_specific.txt) removed the class in the candidate phase but the vision review rejected it for blank lower-page tiles that are equally blank with no filtering at all, so it stays unverified.

## Still visible after the rule

- Citizenship by Investment / Residency by Investment — Entire tile is a blank white region with no visible page content; the Citizenship by Investment and Residency by Investment content that should appear here is absent.
- Residency by Investment / A Global Perspective — Entire tile is a blank white region with no visible page content; the Residency by Investment and A Global Perspective content that should appear here is absent.
- A Global Perspective / As Featured In Top Global Media — Entire tile is a blank white region with no visible page content; the A Global Perspective and As Featured In Top Global Media content that should appear here is absent.
- Entire viewport (header, hero, and first lower section) — Uniform dimming/gating overlay spanning the whole viewport, covering the header, hero content, buttons, and lower page content; matches the reported full-page gcs-cc-lock overlay that blocks interaction.

## Executor and version

Pinned prebuilt release v5.5.2.3

https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/actions/runs/40247867730
